excerpt: IRCC Backlog Update 2025: Why Immigration Delays Are Rising Again Published by: Can X Global Solutions Inc. For millions of immigrants, moving to Canada represents the promise of a better life. Beyond securing employment or building a new career, one of the most powerful and deeply personal goals is homeownership. Owning a home in Canada is not just a financial achievement—it is a marker of stability, security, and long-term belonging.
